description: The event is emitted (src/compiler2/jobs/keying.rs ~360, ~966) and counted by --emit=stats (51 on fz_f98_range_map_converges), and a JSONL handler exists (src/telemetry/jsonl.rs ~716-730), but is_public_compiler2_trace_event (jsonl.rs ~1186-1219) does not allowlist the name, so a --log-telemetry trace never shows what a body's inputs were demanded for. Now that the plan records its own input demand and keying reads it (fz-acn.3), the fact is central and should be inspectable from a trace. Fix: one allowlist arm. Signal: the public_trace_test census gains the event with a pinned count on one fixture.
title: fz.compiler2.input_demand.derived never reaches the --log-telemetry stream
